items.name: Edit
items.summary: A text edit to be applied to a source file. Inserts, deletes, or replaces content at a given location.

methods.name: content
methods.summary: Returns the new content for an insertion or deletion.

methods.name: deletion
methods.signature: const fn deletion(start: TextSize, end: TextSize) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates an edit that deletes the content in the `start` to `end` range.

methods.name: insertion
methods.signature: fn insertion(content: String, at: TextSize) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates an edit that inserts `content` at the [`TextSize`] `at`.

methods.name: is_deletion
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this edit deletes content from the source document.

methods.name: is_insertion
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this edit inserts new content into the source document.

methods.name: is_replacement
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this edit replaces some existing content with new content.

methods.name: range_deletion
methods.summary: Creates an edit that deletes the content in `range`.

methods.name: range_replacement
methods.signature: fn range_replacement(content: String, range: TextRange) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates an edit that replaces the content in `range` with `content`.

methods.name: replacement
methods.signature: fn replacement(content: String, start: TextSize, end: TextSize) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates an edit that replaces the content in the `start` to `end` range with `content`.
